title: Morning Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — September 22, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Very Low (Below A1.0...)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C2.0 (Peaked September 22, 2026 at 04:51 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 310 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Things are pretty quiet. 🤍

Solar images show a broad dark coronal feature and several modest bright regions, while sunspot coverage remains low.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 193 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
